name: Panceta Levels List
description: Browse the Panceta Levels List (PLL) and GPLL in-game.

pll-api-url.name: PLL API URL
pll-api-url.description: JSON endpoint the PLL tab loads its levels from.

gpll-api-url.name: GPLL API URL
gpll-api-url.description: JSON endpoint for the GPLL tab (same format as PLL). Leave empty until the GPLL exists.

show-upll.name: Show UPLL-only levels
show-upll.description: Also show levels that are only on the UPLL (above the PLL skill cap).
